text:
laura: Quick sync — I'm proposing an RBAC change to support emergency, time-limited HSM operator access for oncall when we need to rewrap customer BYOKs (e.g., during a firmware CVE). Before I write the PR, want feedback on controls + audit surface.

chris: High level: must be JIT (just-in-time) with explicit approver, MFA, and enforceable TTL. All operator actions MUST be audited and exported. No key material should ever leave HSM. Also add an automatic rollback window if rewrap fails. :eyes:

anil: Agree. Implementation idea: mint ephemeral IAM creds tied to a short-lived operator session and HSM attestation token. Sample policy (very rough):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["hsm:StartRewrap","hsm:QueryKeyState"],"Resource":"arn:aws:hsm:::customer-key/*","Condition":{"NumericLessThanEquals":{"aws:TokenIssueTime":"300"}}}
  ]
}
```
This would be combined with our JIT service that requires a signed approval from an authorized approver.

jess: From oncall POV — during incidents we can't add friction, but we also can't open wholesale access. Can we pre-bake a playbook that maps who can approve vs who executes? e.g., approver = sec-lead or legal on-call for high-risk customers. Suggested SLA: 30m approval target for P1 (we'll need to align with SRE). Also we should publish a single CLI that wraps the complexity: `rw key rewrap --customer <id> --target-version <v>` so runbook steps are concise.

maya: Legal/compliance note: different customers have different contractual obligations. For regulated customers (banks, health), we need documented chain-of-custody for the rewrap and a packaged evidence bundle for the customer and auditors. Please don't assume uniform retention periods — make retention and evidence export configurable per-tenant. I'll review the template once you have a concrete evidence schema.

ben: On vuln triage: if the HSM firmware has a CVE that requires immediate remediation, we need a safe canary strategy: pick 1-2 low-risk customers, perform rewrap and monitor for replay/latency regressions, then escalate. Also we need an incident tag + ticket in vuln tracker and a mapping from CVE -> minimum mitigations (reboot-only vs rewrap required).

laura: Good call on canary. Two operational questions: 1) audit log shipping — can we stream operator-level audit events to a central, immutable S3 bucket and also optionally forward a copy to the customer's audit endpoint? 2) what fields should be in the evidence bundle? (I sketched a draft below).

chris: For (1) — yes, central immutable bucket (write-once) with object-level locks where supported. We should sign and hash the evidence bundle and store the signature in our WORM store. If customers request forwarding, we need a signed subset (no key material) and mutual TLS to their collector. For (2) required evidence fields: operator identity (with approver chain), session id, HSM attestation statement, command arguments, pre/post key-hash (not plaintext key), rewrap result, and timestamps. Keep the bundle machine-readable (JSON) and include a human-readable summary.

anil: Example CLI output we can capture in the bundle:
```
$ rw key rewrap --customer c-123 --key k-abc --to-version v2
REQUEST_ID=2026-06-15T03:12:11Z-6f9a
APPROVER=chris
OPERATOR=jess
HSM_ATTEST=attestation_blob_base64
PRE_KEY_HASH=sha256:aa34...
POST_KEY_HASH=sha256:bb77...
RESULT=SUCCESS
```
We should also store the HSM attestation blob (base64) and the signed approver assertion.

audit-bot: Scheduled firmware upgrade window detected: 2026-06-18 02:00-04:00 UTC for HSM fleet (non-customer-accessible partitions). Will create a follow-up incident thread for canary plan.

deploy-bot: Created incident INC-20260615-19 for CVE-xxxx. Assigned to @ben and @laura.

jess: Operational concerns — rewrap can sometimes increase latency for in-flight sessions. We need a clear fallback to the previous key version for a short time window and an automatic alert if >0.5% of requests error post-wrap. Also need a playtest run (non-prod) and a tabletop drill for oncall.

laura: Action items I will take: 1) draft RBAC change PR with JIT + TTL + approver flow, 2) draft evidence JSON schema and CLI capture format, 3) coordinate canary list with @ben and @anil, 4) schedule a tabletop for oncall + legal. Anyone want to own the retention/settings per-tenant config?

maya: Legal will own compliance mapping per-contract. I'll create a checklist and flag customers that need explicit consent before any rewrap.

chris: Security will review PR and define required encryption+signing for bundles. I'll also define the minimum audit retention for SOC2/PCI evidence (will share a short policy doc). :thumbsup:

laura: Thanks — I'll open the PR this afternoon and attach the initial evidence schema. If we can get signoffs this week we can run the canary during the scheduled patch window. :rocket:
